Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.

samples.text: Floating-point addition is not associative because the order in which you add numbers can affect the result due to rounding errors. For example, (a + b) + c ≠ a + (b + c) when a, b, and c are floating-point numbers. This is because the intermediate result of a + b may not be exactly representable as a floating-point number, leading to a different result when adding c.
